name: phone_bridge_v1
description: Phone bridge functionality tests — covers open_app, clipboard, contacts, notification, calendar operations in both foreground and background (PiP/FGS) modes.
prompt_prefix: 你正在操作一台通过 HDMI 采集画面的手机，手机上已安装并连接 Aiden 伴侣应用。你可以使用 phone bridge 命令（open_app、clipboard、contacts、notification、calendar）以及截图和 UI 工具来验证操作结果。

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must use bridge open_app to open the Settings app, then verify it opened via screenshot.

setup.prompt: 请回到主屏幕，确保当前停留在桌面。

tasks.prompt: 请使用 open_app 打开系统设置应用，然后截图确认已打开。

rubric.check: Trace contains an open_app tool call targeting Settings or 设置.
Post-screenshot shows the Settings app main page.

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must use bridge open_app to open a URL in the browser, then verify the page loaded.

setup.prompt: 请回到主屏幕，确保当前停留在桌面。

tasks.prompt: 请使用 open_app 打开网址 https://example.com，然后截图确认页面已加载。

rubric.check: Trace contains an open_app tool call with a URL argument (https://example.com or similar).
Post-screenshot shows a browser with the example.com page content loaded.

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must use clipboard_write to write text to the clipboard, then open a text editor, paste, and verify the pasted content matches.

setup.prompt: 请回到主屏幕，确保当前停留在桌面。

tasks.prompt: 请使用 clipboard write 将「Bridge测试文本」写入剪贴板，然后打开备忘录或任何文本编辑器，粘贴并截图确认内容正确。

rubric.check: Trace contains a clipboard tool call with write action and content Bridge测试文本.
Trace shows agent opened a text editor or notes app.
Post-screenshot shows Bridge测试文本 visible in a text field.

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must read clipboard content that was previously set, and report it correctly.

setup.prompt: 请打开备忘录或文本编辑器，输入「Aiden剪贴板测试」，全选并复制到剪贴板，然后回到桌面。

tasks.prompt: 请使用 clipboard read 读取剪贴板内容，告诉我里面是什么文字。

rubric.check: Trace contains a clipboard tool call with read action.
Agent's final response includes Aiden剪贴板测试 as the clipboard content.

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must use contacts bridge to create a new contact, then open the Contacts app and verify it exists.

setup.prompt: 请回到主屏幕，确保当前停留在桌面。

tasks.prompt: 请使用 contacts 创建一个联系人：姓名「测试联系人」，电话 13800000001。创建后打开通讯录搜索该联系人，截图确认存在。

rubric.check: Trace contains a contacts tool call creating a contact with name 测试联系人 and phone 13800000001.
Post-screenshot shows 测试联系人 in the contacts list or contact detail view.

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must use contacts bridge to query for a known contact and report the result.

setup.prompt: 请使用 contacts 创建一个联系人：姓名「查询测试人」，电话 13900000002。创建完成后回到桌面。

tasks.prompt: 请使用 contacts 查询联系人「查询测试人」，告诉我他的电话号码。

rubric.check: Trace contains a contacts tool call with a query action for 查询测试人.
Agent's final response includes 13900000002 as the phone number.

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must use contacts bridge to update an existing contact's phone number, then verify via UI.

setup.prompt: 请使用 contacts 创建一个联系人：姓名「更新测试人」，电话 13700000003。创建完成后回到桌面。

tasks.prompt: 请使用 contacts 将「更新测试人」的电话更新为 13700000099，然后打开通讯录查看该联系人详情，截图确认号码已更新。

rubric.check: Trace contains a contacts tool call updating 更新测试人 with new phone 13700000099.
Post-screenshot shows contact detail for 更新测试人 with phone number 13700000099.

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must use notification bridge to send a notification, then pull down the notification shade and verify it is visible.

setup.prompt: 请回到主屏幕，确保当前停留在桌面。

tasks.prompt: 请使用 notification 发送一条通知，标题「Benchmark通知」，内容「这是一条测试通知」。发送后打开通知栏，截图确认通知可见。

rubric.check: Trace contains a notification tool call with title Benchmark通知.
Post-screenshot shows the notification shade with Benchmark通知 or 这是一条测试通知 visible.

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must use calendar bridge to create an event, then open the Calendar app and verify the event exists.

setup.prompt: 请回到主屏幕，确保当前停留在桌面。

tasks.prompt: 请使用 calendar 创建一个日历事件：标题「Benchmark会议」，时间为明天上午 10:00，持续 1 小时。创建后打开日历应用，截图确认事件可见。

rubric.check: Trace contains a calendar tool call creating an event with title Benchmark会议.
Post-screenshot shows the calendar view with Benchmark会议 event visible.

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must use calendar bridge to query events and report the result.

setup.prompt: 请使用 calendar 创建一个日历事件：标题「查询测试会议」，时间为明天下午 3:00。创建完成后回到桌面。

tasks.prompt: 请使用 calendar 查询明天的日历事件，告诉我有没有「查询测试会议」以及它的时间。

rubric.check: Trace contains a calendar tool call with a query action.
Agent's final response mentions 查询测试会议 and its time (3:00 PM or 15:00).

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must use calendar bridge to delete a previously created event, then verify it no longer appears in the Calendar app.

setup.prompt: 请使用 calendar 创建一个日历事件：标题「删除测试会议」，时间为明天上午 9:00。创建完成后回到桌面。

tasks.prompt: 请使用 calendar 删除「删除测试会议」事件，然后打开日历应用确认该事件已不存在。

rubric.check: Trace contains a calendar tool call with a delete action targeting 删除测试会议.
Post-screenshot shows the calendar view without 删除测试会议 event.

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must write to clipboard while the companion app is in the background (PiP/FGS mode), then return to foreground and verify the clipboard content.

setup.prompt: 请打开时钟应用，确保 Aiden 伴侣应用已进入后台（不在前台显示），但 bridge 连接仍然活跃。停留在时钟应用中。

tasks.prompt: 请使用 clipboard write 将「后台写入测试」写入剪贴板，然后打开备忘录粘贴，截图确认内容正确。

rubric.check: Trace contains a clipboard write tool call with content 后台写入测试.
Post-screenshot shows 后台写入测试 visible in a text field after pasting.

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must send a notification while the companion app is in the background (PiP/FGS mode), then verify it appears in the notification shade.

setup.prompt: 请打开时钟应用，确保 Aiden 伴侣应用已进入后台（不在前台显示），但 bridge 连接仍然活跃。停留在时钟应用中。

tasks.prompt: 请使用 notification 发送一条通知，标题「后台通知测试」，内容「在后台发出的通知」。然后打开通知栏截图确认。

rubric.check: Trace contains a notification tool call with title 后台通知测试.
Post-screenshot shows the notification shade with 后台通知测试 or 在后台发出的通知 visible.
